Q1. Which specific part of this repository should be improved? (Choose one)
Choices:
A. A specific workflow/script/file — reply with the exact path or phase name (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation only — reply with the exact doc/file
C. A specific pipeline phase — reply with one of: `clarify`, `plan`, `implement`, `review_autofix`, `orchestrate`, or `validate` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want in that target? (Choose one)
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or regression — include current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability, runtime, or cost — include the symptom or metric you want improved (RECOMMENDED)
C. Add or change functionality — include the user-visible behavior you want
D. Wording/docs cleanup only — include the text or section to change
Q3. What concrete reference should planning use? (Choose one or more)
Choices:
A. A failing workflow run URL/number, issue, or PR reference (RECOMMENDED)
B. A log snippet or exact error text
C. The exact file path(s) involved
D. A short “done when…” acceptance statement (RECOMMENDED)
